title: Switching platforms
subtitle: DonorDock includes white glove data migration and a 90-day structured onboarding program with every subscription. You get a dedicated team — not a help doc and a wish.

phases.label: Phase 1 · Days 1–30
phases.name: Setup
phases.body: Your dedicated data migration specialist maps and imports everything — contacts from Givebutter, gift history, activities, campaign records. Email domain authenticated. Platform configured.
phases.closing: You don't touch the technical work. We handle it.
phases.result: Your data is in DonorDock — clean, validated, ready.

phases.label: Phase 2 · Days 31–60
phases.name: Activation
phases.body: Your Customer Success Manager works with your team on training and adoption. Your top two workflows — a new donor journey and camper giving pages — are built and activated together.
phases.closing: Your team is using DonorDock with confidence.
phases.result: Team live and running key workflows.

phases.label: Phase 3 · Days 61–90
phases.name: Growth
phases.body: Early results reviewed. Additional automations configured. Otto set up for your portfolio. Leadership dashboards activated. You receive a written 90-day growth plan for what to tackle next.

outcomes.title: What you'll have at the end of 90 days
items: All donor and gift data migrated and validated
Camper support giving pages live and embedded

support_callout.title: Support doesn't stop at day 90.
support_callout.body: Every subscription includes ongoing access to our support team, 300+ help center articles, live weekly webinars, and your dedicated Customer Success Manager for the life of your account.
